test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The **correct answer** is 'Option 2' i.e. '**industries'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• From the context of the sentence, it's clear that the** blank is referring to something related to the activities happening in the Tees area**, which are linked to steel and chemicals.
 
• The word** 'industries'** fits perfectly in this context, as the sentence speaks about the type of industries that were present in the Tees area.
 
• The format of the sentence indicates plural form hence **'industries' **is grammatically correct as well.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is 'Option 2' i.e**. 'industries'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Fabrication'** usually refers to the act of inventing or producing something false in order to deceive someone, or the act of making or building something, especially something large or complex.
 
• **'Monopoly' **refers to the complete control of the entire supply of goods or of a service in a certain area or market.
 
• **'Salutation' **is a greeting or gesture of respect or reverence.
